resources.string: Each phone can share and listen at the same time. To share both ways, start sharing on each phone and exchange invitations.
Select playlists to share their names, song order and local music. Other devices’ music stays with its original owner.
Choose up to 100 playlists. Each shares up to 5,000 local songs. You can choose all device music again after selecting playlists.
This invitation belongs to this phone. Use it on another device.
This device is already connected. Use device management to change its address.
Save loaded songs to a playlist
No shared playlists here yet. Select playlists on the sharing phone. Both phones need version 1324 or later.
The first 5,000 local songs are shared from this playlist.
Save a playlist to your library and stream its music directly from the original devices. Those devices must be online and keep your access approved.
%1$d songs need a connection to their original devices. You can save the playlist now and connect those devices later.
Could not load playlists from %1$s. Refresh the library to retry.
